3 11-12-2023 I.A. No. 9490 of 2016 1. This is an application to substitute the name of Naresh Kumar Singh, who is son of the original petitioner Vidya Singh who died on 25.04.2015.

2. For the reasons mentioned, this application is allowed and let the name of the petitioner Vidya Singh be deleted from the array of the parties and in his place, the name of Naresh Kumar Singh (Son) be substituted.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
4. The contention of the petitioner is that there is 4 Kathas of land belonging to him has been utilized by the respondents for construction of a road.
5. Learned counsel for the state submits that only 1 decimal land of the petitioner has been utilized for construction of the road.

sentences.text: It is not in dispute that there has been no land acquisition proceeding for utilizing the land belonging to the petitioner.
The only dispute is that how much of land of the petitioner has been utilized for constructing the road.

7. In these circumstances, the authorities are directed to get the land measured in presence of the petitioner and thereafter they are directed to pay the compensation in accordance with law under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
8.
